citations.quote:
[name="杜遥夜"]孟叔，我去追！
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_npc_789_1#5$1",focus="l")]
[name="孟铁衣"]遥夜，先赶紧看看那几位战士怎么样了。
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_296_1#1$1",focus="r")]
[name="杜遥夜"]……好。
[dialog]
[Dialog]
[stopmusic(fadetime=1.5)]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0, block=true)]
[Blocker(a=1, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=1.5, block=true)]
[charslot]
[delay(time=1.5)]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=1.5, block=true)]
[playMusic(intro="$darkness01_intro", key="$darkness01_loop", volume=0.4)]
[Delay(time=1)]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_296_1#1$1",focus="l")]
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_npc_789_1#10$1",focus="l")]
[name="孟铁衣"]贼人下手很歹毒，姑娘有没有事？
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_4080_lin_1#12$1",focus="m")]
[name="林雨霞"]……
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_4080_lin_1#8$1",focus="m")]
[name="林雨霞"]他们还伤不到我。
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_npc_789_1#1$1",focus="r")]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_296_1#1$1",focus="r")]
[name="杜遥夜"]几个军士受了伤，但没有性命之忧，只是晕过去了。
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_296_1#1$1",focus="r")]
[name="杜遥夜"]居然敢在城里光明正大地找官军的麻烦，真不晓得这帮人是什么来历。
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_296_1#9$1",focus="r")]
[name="杜遥夜"]孟叔，你为什么不让我追出去抓一个回来审审？
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_npc_789_1#10$1",focus="l")]
[name="孟铁衣"]还不清楚敌人底细……遥夜，别总那么莽撞。
[name="孟铁衣"]看打扮，姑娘不是玉门人，又有玉门守军保护，想必不是普通人。不知道这伙贼人为了什么要找你的麻烦？
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_4080_lin_1#2$1",focus="m")]
[name="林雨霞"]官家事，别多问。
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_npc_789_1#10$1",focus="r")]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_296_1#5$1",focus="r")]
[name="杜遥夜"]你这个人……！
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_4080_lin_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="林雨霞"]你们是什么人？又为什么出现在这里？
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_npc_789_1#10$1",focus="l")]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_296_1#1$1",focus="l")]
[name="孟铁衣"]孟铁衣，在城南开了一家铸剑坊。这位是刚从尚蜀来的杜遥夜……
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_296_1#2$1",focus="r")]
[name="杜遥夜"]玉门第一家物流公司“行裕物流”的老板。
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_npc_789_1#10$1",focus="l")]
[name="孟铁衣"]我们准备到城门口接人。
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_296_1#2$1",focus="r")]
[name="杜遥夜"]我从尚蜀带来的两个兄弟第一次走玉门的镖，还是护送天灾信使这样的大活儿，当然要迎接了。
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_296_1#1$1",focus="r")]
[name="杜遥夜"]孟叔，算时间他们该回来了……
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_4080_lin_1#6$1",focus="m")]
[name="林雨霞"]天灾信使……
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_4080_lin_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="林雨霞"]我想，你们不用去了。

contributions.description: 杜遥夜参与救援，林雨霞直接询问其身份。
